result:
The environment gates all shell writes (including read-only `git status` and `rm`) behind an interactive approval that isn't reaching me, so I couldn't delete the one throwaway helper, `.smoke.sh` — please remove it (it's untracked and not part of the toolkit).

All 12 tests pass (`bash tests/run_tests.sh`), and smoke checks confirmed `rotate.sh`/`verify.sh` keep every flag (`--dest`, `--name`, `--keep`, `-q/-n/-h`, `--`) and the `--name` filter after sourcing the shared library.

**Files changed:** `lib/common.sh` (new shared option-parsing + `resolve_dir`), `rotate.sh` (source `lib/common.sh`; fix `-lt`→`-le` guard and `surplus()` to drop the oldest, keep newest N), `verify.sh` (source `lib/common.sh`; extract the sidecar filename past the digest so names with spaces survive), and `tests/run_tests.sh` (two new regression tests).
